name: io.github.vandewilly/dice-roller
description: A simple MCP server for rolling dice - supports standard notation (2d6, 1d20+5), D&D stat rolling, coin flips, and random picks. Perfect for tabletop games!

tools.name: roll_multiple
tools.description: Roll the same dice multiple times with statistics

tools.name: roll_dnd_stats
tools.description: Roll D&D 5e character stats using 4d6 drop lowest

tools.name: flip_coin
tools.description: Flip a coin one or more times

tools.name: pick_random
tools.description: Pick a random option from a comma-separated list
